entities.summary: Bulgan is a town which is the administrative centre of Bulgan Province of Mongolia. Bulgan sum has a population of 11,984, 12,323 (2008), town proper has a population of 11,198 (2008). It is located at the site of the former Daichin Wangiin Khüree monastery at an elevation of 1,208 metres (3,963 ft) and 468 kilometres (291 mi) from Ulaanbaatar.
